Classiq announced a Fault Tolerance Engine designed to enable quantum software developers to run their algorithms on fault‑tolerant quantum hardware without needing extensive error‑correction expertise. The engine bridges current noisy intermediate‑scale quantum (NISQ) applications with advanced error‑corrected devices, allowing hybrid classical–quantum execution that preserves algorithmic performance while reducing resource overheads. This initiative aims to streamline the transition from prototype quantum code to scalable, hardware‑agnostic solutions.
